heading: 5.3 Built-in derived dimensions and units (partial list)
text:
### 5.3 Built-in derived dimensions and units (partial list) [LUNI.5.3]

| Dimension | Base unit | Notable units |
|---|---|---|
| `velocity` | `meters_per_second` | `kilometers_per_hour` (kmh,kph), `miles_per_hour` (mph), `knot` |
| `acceleration` | `meters_per_second_squared` | `g_force` |
| `force` | `newton` (N) | `kilonewton` (kN), `dyne`, `pound_force` (lbf) |
| `energy` | `joule` (J) | `kilojoule`, `kilowatt_hour` (kWh), `calorie`, `erg` |
| `power` | `watt` (W) | `kilowatt`, `megawatt`, `horsepower` (hp) |
| `pressure` | `pascal` (Pa) | `kilopascal`, `megapascal`, `hectopascal`, `bar`, `psi`, `atm`, `mmhg` |
| `density` | `kilograms_per_m3` | `grams_per_cm3` |
| `flow_rate` | `m3_per_second` | `litres_per_minute` (lpm), `gallons_per_minute` (gpm) |
| `voltage` | `volt` (V) | see standard library |
| `current` | `ampere` (A) | see standard library |
| `resistance` | `ohm` | `kilohm`, `megohm` |
| `capacitance` | `farad` (F) | `microfarad` (uF), `nanofarad` (nF), `picofarad` (pF) |
| `inductance` | `henry` (H) | `millihenry` (mH), `microhenry` (uH) |
| `illuminance` | `lux` | see standard library |
| `luminance` | `candela_per_meter_squared` | alias `nit`; 1000 nit = typical HDR display |
| `magnetic_flux_density` | `tesla` (T) | `millitesla`, `microtesla`, `gauss` (G) |
